summary: SciSparc Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K comprising its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, with XBRL tagging across segments including drug development, online sales and quantum technology, plus subsequent-event disclosures. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is described; the filing is a routine periodic reporting package furnished under the 1934 Act, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. Watch for future 6-K disclosures on financing, warrants, or strategic moves rather than deal terms here.
